reuse.why: Extends the existing shouldFillCategory in fill-categories.ts, the tree's single definition of which categories month-wide actions fill, so all month-wide actions pick up the template rule.

duplication.why: Rule added once; the only repetition is setZero's new categories+groups query, which copies the one getAverageCategories already runs.

placement.why: Template rule lives in fill-categories.ts, the module documented as the single definition for month-wide fill eligibility.

scope.why: Small and focused: goal_def added to the candidate type and budget query, one predicate, and setZero switched to skip hidden.

maintainability.why: Clear single predicate with a comment; minor wart is the duplicated query in setZero instead of sharing a category-loading helper.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions go through shouldFillCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied SQL in setZero is a plain copy of getAverageCategories' query, not disguised.

one_place.where: hasSavedTemplates inside shouldFillCategory in budget/fill-categories.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the average actions.
